steps.content: [Scene Change] Corridor

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The situation in the West District is critical. A shortage of Hypercubes has forced Syndicate to prioritize securing the new mine over protecting civilian facilities. To make matters worse, the contaminated shackles also have an impact on them...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Many Sinners, including Matilda, have registered at the Bureau and been connected to the shackles. Now they're all affected by BR-005's contamination, struggling with their basic duties, let alone defending anyone.
[Scene Change] Communications, FAC Front Line

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: Who are you?
Siglinde steps forward and salutes, her face a mask of powder-stained dust.

steps.speaker: Siglinde
steps.content: Sir, I'm Siglinde, Senior Wartime Liaison Officer from the Eighth Division of DisCorps. General Augustus assigned me to assist with your battle operations.

steps.speaker: Siglinde
steps.content: I've finished visiting all FAC forward positions to provide comms upgrade assistance. Now, I request permission to deliver my report on personnel casualties across the board directly to you. Do you have some time now?

steps.speaker: Siglinde
steps.content: I should warn you, sir, the details are extensive.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander-in-Chief
steps.content: ...Go ahead. I'm listening.
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: The Tide of Ashes continues to expand its reach, now consuming over seventy percent of the West District. The surge is poised to cross the Rust at any moment, putting the entire Eastside in imminent danger. The number of affected civilians is climbing by the hour. Dozens of underground shelters have now reached capacity, and emergency crews are scrambling to coordinate relocations.

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: In the midst of this chaos, we've seen violent incidents break out in several overcrowded areas, with Outland immigrants reportedly being targeted. Speaker Max King was also caught in one of these altercations while organizing an evacuation and sustained minor injuries.
[Scene Change] Syndicate Streets

steps.speaker: Panicked Civilian
steps.content: My brother's in there! He's still under the rubble! Somebody, please! Help him, I'm begging you!!

steps.speaker: Panicked Civilian
steps.content: It hurts... It's burning hot... Help me...

steps.speaker: Panicked Civilian
steps.content: Why is this happening... hnngh... WAAAHH—

N.F. 115/08/05 01:31
Patrol Unit FAC-207 wiped out, 137 confirmed KIA, location: west sector of District Z12

N.F. 115/08/05 09:24
Sheriff Squad B ambushed at Central Water Tower, 10 KIA, 3 MIA
|

N.F. 115/08/06 13:53
Mobile Unit FAC-311 lost contact at East Link stairway entrance, 42 presumed KIA

N.F. 115/08/06 20:11
Explosion at main avenue intersection, 2 FAC personnel KIA, 1 critically wounded
|

N.F. 115/08/07 02:37
West District alleyway, 25 civilian fatalities due to structural collapse, 72 with minor injuries

N.F. 115/08/07 04:56
South District Station temporary shelter report: 121 civilians with minor injuries, 3 with severe injuries
|
[Scene Change] MBCC
The battle report terminal in your hand is screen-shattered, yet casualty updates continue to flicker across the fractured display.

Outside your office, the hallway echoes with a rising tide of commotion. More and more registered Sinners are being affected by worsening contamination from the shackles, rushed to the MBCC for emergency aid. The Bureau has never been this chaotic.
And you—the source of the contaminated shackles—are not immune either. The approaching BR-005 weighs on you, an immense pressure that churns the contamination within, making it surge relentlessly.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Apostles are deliberately avoiding DisSea, which contradicts their nature. The evidence suggests the enemy is using BR-005 to deliberately restrain them.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It seems that both the farlands and Fraser still fear BR-000. They don't dare let the Apostles enter and risk triggering an uncontrollable change.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, you mustn't shoulder this burden alone. Your body can't withstand much more of this stress.
Your knuckles bleach white around the terminal as the battle reports flash relentlessly. Each update sends the casualty count climbing.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ..."The situation still remains within projected parameters." "Current events are proceeding within expected outcomes. It will be resolved." That's what you said.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Yes, current events are still proceeding within expected outcomes. You don't need to worry.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Has the FAC finally stabilized their defensive line? Do they have the strength to push the Apostles out of the city?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Regrettably, no. The FAC's main forces are still committed to DisSea, struggling against the Tide of Ashes. Based on current data, the confrontation line is continuing to advance deeper into the urban sectors.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are there any forces we can use to hit those city-states directly? Or do we have any means to strike them from the inside?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Unfortunately, our intelligence networks and trade routes remain compromised. The enemy was exceptionally well-prepared for this conflict. They have decisively seized the initiative.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then... is there a way to punch through their lines? Something to directly break BR-005, their tactical core?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Targeting BR-005 would be the most efficient solution, I agree. We have confirmed its location, but it is now surrounded by a growing concentration of Apostles of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This Black Ring exerts a powerful attraction and control over the Apostles. Broken Blade Squad 3's previous approach was, in fact, designed by the enemy. They are not likely to give us another such opportunity.
The mechanical triangle parries each "solution" you can think of with a calm, methodical precision, utterly devoid of anxiety.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just remembered... you had another method before...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Two years ago, with BR-002. The person behind you proposed a plan. I would enter the Black Ring, find the Corpseborne, and act as a beacon. That way, you could fire the high-energy "Rules" and turn both the enemy and me into ash.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now I can't enter the Black Ring, but there's someone inside, marked by the shackles, and she's probably close to the core...
[Hella's Portrait]

options: Are you considering using that on her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You want to use me to locate Hella, and then gamble that a locked-on strike through her will break BR-005's core? Is that it?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, please, try to remain calm. Your contamination levels are spiking. And I'd advise against swatting at me. Excessive motion compromises my treatment's efficacy.
It hovers, performs several scans, administers an injection, and then returns to the previous topic.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The scenario you describe is, technically, a viable option. It is the most economical and controllable path we have.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: However, we all know that your current willpower and ethical stance prevent you from supporting the plan's execution. And we cannot afford to lose you at the moment. When weighing the costs, the necessary sacrifice becomes clear.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: So, please rest assured. We have a backup plan, and it is progressing smoothly.
A sigh of relief escapes you, quickly followed by a stronger wave of confusion.

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...So what exactly is this backup plan?

steps.content: Schorl's only answer is a prolonged scan, continuing long after your Mania levels have subsided.
After what feels like an age, the mechanical triangle finally speaks again.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, some patterns never change, even in this era.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Faced with catastrophes and Mania, humanity will still choose to fight amongst itself rather than unite for a solution. The fighting, the hatred... it continues.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We know war is a constant. So, any power that can bring victory will be weaponized. We calculated the possibility of "catastrophe warfare" long ago. We've also gathered ample data to verify the enemy's technological capabilities...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: With help from the Underground, the farlands acquired a Black Ring with exceptional attraction to the Apostles of Ashes. It migrates like an Apostle itself and gathers the Apostles to advance on DisCity, creating the most violent Tide of Ashes—one far beyond our current defenses.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is the full extent of their capability. It is impressive, but it is also their limit.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Understanding the Apostles is the pinnacle of Outland technology. But in the entire field of Mania research, they cannot compete with DisCity.
The black triangle doesn't answer. It attempts reassurance again, but its offer rings hollow in a voice mechanical as always, yet colder than ever before.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: There is no need for concern. Everything is proceeding as calculated. We've reached this stage thanks to your efforts; the plan's smooth execution is, in large part, your achievement.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We appreciate your hard work, Chief. Now, please. Get some rest. Leave the rest to us.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The war will soon end.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What are you really—
A chorus of startled cries echoes in the air, immediately chased by hurried footsteps. People begin to swarm, a chaotic current pulling them outside.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What's happening...?
Suddenly, a city-wide broadcast overrides all DisCity frequencies, its signal pulsing from every screen and speaker at once.

steps.speaker: EDGE-03
steps.content: Citizens of DisCity, members of the Farland Alliance, and people of all other territories... This is EDGE, addressing all of humanity.

steps.speaker: EDGE-03
steps.content: The Exploration, Defence and Governance Entente was founded for one purpose: to combat Mania and secure the future of our civilization. Since then, we have strictly maintained our neutrality, refraining from interfering with humanity's choices in matters beyond the protocol's scope.

steps.speaker: EDGE-03
steps.content: It has never been our intention to restrict the freedom of city-states to pursue their own paths. But when we're faced with decisions that threaten the survival of our entire species, EDGE must act. We cannot stand by and allow humanity to walk the path of self-destruction.

steps.speaker: EDGE-03
steps.content: If we had any other choice, we wouldn't take such drastic measures. But this war... it must end now.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: Hey!
A Senate order, routed through the Mania dark web, drops like a bomb, shocking everyone.

—Our city-state is under anomalous attack. All offensive operations cease immediately. Prioritize defensive measures.

—Communication channels are severely compromised. All units hold position until repairs are complete.

—Repeat: This is a highest-level alert. All offensive operations cease immediately.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: ...Those DisCity bastards...!!
[Scene Change] On the Way Back to the City
On the return path to the city, for the first time, Broken Blade Squad 3 halts in its tracks. The apparition before them is so staggering that even these hardened soldiers hold their breath.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: General...
Augustus looks up at the sky.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Rusted Voice
steps.content: We hear it... their blood still flowing, their cries a fanfare for our victory...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Rusted Voice
steps.content: Their only fate is to be shattered... to become mere dust beneath our blades.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Bastards...
[Scene Change]
You exit the Bureau and step into an open area.
The Tide of Ashes—driven by the farlands and plaguing DisCity for nearly a week—has finally subsided. As the sandstorm weakens and the dust settles, the sky becomes clearly visible again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What... is that...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...It's a <color=#fb9259>weapon</color>. We use it to maintain peace, a necessary measure in the face of calamity.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Nine years ago, a similar scenario once played out. It seems that human nature is truly constant.
Overhead, the optical camouflage fades, revealing several black triangles floating silently. They pulse with a soft blue light, their energy connecting to form a massive barrier.
At the center of this barrier, a massive shadow is imprisoned—a distorted sight all too familiar to you.
[BR-003] Transition 2s

steps.speaker: EDGE-03
steps.content: We abhor war, yet we will not yield to it. In the struggle against injustice, civilization shall be reforged, and technology shall advance once more.

steps.speaker: EDGE-03
steps.content: If humanity refuses reason, then EDGE will correct your course.
